policy_title: Protect First Past the Post Electoral System
stated: The Conservative Party remains committed to the First Past the Post system for elections, maintaining the direct link with the local voter, and will not change the voting age from 18.

source.quote: We remain steadfast in our support for the fundamental principles that underpin the UK’s constitutional settlement. We remain committed to the First Past the Post system for elections, maintaining the direct link with the local voter. We will not change the voting age from 18.

bearing_set.reason: Electoral system design and voting-age rules directly determine voting & democratic rights — how votes translate into representation and who can participate — placing this squarely within O9's explicit 'voting & democratic rights' indicator.

membership_note: This is a genuine single-target policy: its sole material effect is on democratic rights and electoral representation (O9). Effects on other fundamentals — e.g. whether FPTP's partisan outcomes influence redistribution (O14) or civic engagement (O15) — are too indirect and speculative to clear the non-negligible bar with a pinnable mechanism and indicator.
